months = [('2026-01', 120000), ('2026-02', 150000), ('2026-03', 90000)]
def mom(series):
    out = []
    for i in range(1, len(series)):
        prev, cur = series[i - 1][1], series[i][1]
        out.append((series[i][0], round(100 * (cur - prev) / prev, 1)))
    return out
print('total:', sum(v for _, v in months), '| best:', max(months, key=lambda m: m[1]))
print('mom:', mom(months))

questions.question: why: Dashboard me total sahi hai par per-region totals ka sum mismatch hai — likely cause?
questions.answer: Grain ka fan-out: order-items level join se rows multiply ho gayi (double counting), ya filter context alag hai (page-level filter vs visual filter), ya koi NULL/unknown bucket ek jagah count ho raha hai doosri jagah nahi. Pehle grain confirm karo: 1 row = 1 order ya 1 order-item?

questions.question: fix: Kaun sa edge case growth ya percentage metrics ko todta hai?

questions.question: design: Data quality checks source par lagao ya BI model me?
questions.answer: Primary checks source/ELT par (grain, key uniqueness, null rates, referential integrity) taaki model saaf data par bane; Power BI me sirf display-level sanity (totals reconcile, outliers visible). DAX me data cleaning karna tech debt hai — logic do jagah bikharta hai.
questions.explanation: Cleaning ko upstream rakho: ek hi definition, model me sirf measure/logic. Warna same business rule ke kai versions ban jate hain.

questions.question: tradeoff: Dashboard slow hai — pehle kya optimize karoge?
questions.answer: Pehle model (star schema, correct grain, unnecessary columns/relationships hatao), phir DAX (iterator `SUMX` ki jagah column aggregate, `CALCULATE` filter count kam karo), phir visual count aur incremental refresh. Measure page ka time sabse pehle.
questions.explanation: BI performance ka 80% model design hai — DAX micro-tuning tab kaam aati hai jab grain aur relationships sahi hon.

questions.question: BI report me 'total sales' ka sum rows ke average se match nahi kar raha. Kaunsi concept chal rahi hai?
questions.answer: Filter context: tabular visual ka row-level context aggregate ko change karta hai, jabki card/overall visual poore context par aggregate karta hai. KPI ko denominator/context ke saath define karo, warna same naam ke do numbers aayenge.
questions.explanation: Context aggregate ka matlab badalta hai.

questions.question: Ratio metric (conversion rate) ko sum karne par galat aata hai — kyun?
questions.answer: Ratios additive nahi hote; Σ(num)/Σ(den) karo, average of ratios nahi. Power BI/Excel me measure = DIVIDE(SUM(conv), SUM(visits)), aur zero denominator par DIVIDE/IFERROR se bachao.
questions.explanation: Ratio ko re-aggregate karo.

questions.question: Star schema me fact aur dimension table ka farq operational terms me batao.
questions.answer: Fact table events/measures rakhti hai (orders, revenue) aur dimensions attributes (customer, product, date). Isi split se slicing/filtering fast hoti hai aur DAX measures simple rehte hain.
questions.explanation: Measures fact me, attributes dimension me.

questions.question: Relationship cardinality many-to-many ho to kya problem aati hai?
questions.answer: Ambiguous aggregation (numbers duplicate ya under-count ho jaate hain) aur slow queries. Fix: bridge table banao (grain define karke) ya grain ko fact me le aao, phir tests se expected totals verify karo.
questions.explanation: Grain define kernel.

questions.question: Time intelligence me YTD calculate karne ka sahi basis kya hai?
questions.answer: Ek proper date dimension (continuous dates, marked as date table) chahiye; uske bina TOTALYTD/DATESYTD unreliable hote hain. Fiscal year ho to fiscal calendar mapping dimension me rakho.
questions.explanation: Date dimension ke bina time intelligence nahi.

questions.question: KPI me 'active user' define karne ke do options aur farq?
questions.answer: Options: unique users with any event in period vs users crossing an engagement threshold (n events in 7 days). Pehla sasta par inflated, doosra meaningful par complex. Definition document karo aur ek hi use karo.
questions.explanation: Definition lock karo.

questions.question: Report refresh ke baad numbers badal gaye (kal vs aaj). Kaunsi cheezein check karoge?
questions.answer: Data snapshot/late-arriving data, time zone/day boundary, source system change, aur report filter context. Isliye 'as of' timestamp display karo aur daily snapshot table rakho taaki history stable rahe.
questions.explanation: Snapshot ke bina history badalti rehti hai.

questions.question: Seasonality ko moving average se kaise dekhoge?
questions.answer: Rolling 7/28-day average se weekly seasonality smooth hoti hai aur trend dikhta hai; year-over-year comparison se seasonality compare hoti hai. Raw daily numbers se trend claim mat karo.
questions.explanation: Rolling + YoY.

questions.question: Top-N visual me 'Others' category kyun zaroori hai?
questions.answer: Warna long tail ka total gayab ho jaata hai aur percentages 100% se match nahi karte. Practical: top 10 + Others, aur 'Others' ko aggregate karne ke baad hi share calculate karo.
questions.explanation: Long tail hide mat karo.

questions.question: Cumulative (running total) visual me gaps kyun aate hain?
questions.answer: Days jahan data nahi hai woh date dimension me nahi hote, isliye cumulative line me jump theek but gaps dikhte hain. Fix: date dimension se join karo aur CALCULATE ke saath ALLSELECTED/ALL use karo.
questions.explanation: Date spine chahiye.

questions.question: Drill-down me numbers change ho jaate hain. Kaunsi inconsistency?
questions.answer: Different levels par different aggregation (parent me distinct customers, child me counts) ho rahi hai. Har level ka metric explicitly define karo aur totals ko non-additive mark karo.
questions.explanation: Non-additive metric ko label karo.

questions.question: Report me 'no data' rows dikhane ke liye kya karte ho?
questions.answer: Date/category dimension ke saath POISSON/blank-fill join karo (ya crossjoin) aur count 0 dikhao — warna trend me din gayab ho jaate hain. Saath me 'days with no data' count report karo.
questions.explanation: Sparse days fill karo.

questions.question: Slicer aur page-level filter ka interaction samjhao.
questions.answer: Filters intersect karte hain (AND), isliye slicer + page filter ek saath lagane se result khaali aa sakta hai. Har filter ka intent likho aur 'clear all' affordance do, warna user ko confusion hoti hai.
questions.explanation: Filters AND karte hain.

questions.question: Percentage-of-total measure kahan galat ho jaata hai?
questions.answer: Jab context (filter) ke hisaab se denominator badalta hai — jaise 'share of selected region' vs 'share of all'. ALL/ALLSELECTED ka farq yahi hai; purpose ke hisaab se explicitly chuno.
questions.explanation: ALL vs ALLSELECTED ka farq.

questions.question: Dashboard me metric ka variance (noise) kaise handle karte ho?
questions.answer: Significance thresholds (min sample size), confidence band ya control chart, aur 'low sample' warning. Chhoti sample par 100% dikhana misleading hota hai.
questions.explanation: Sample size guard.

questions.question: DirectQuery aur Import mode me choice kaise karte ho?
questions.answer: Import: fast interactivity, scheduled refresh, memory cost — analytics ke liye default. DirectQuery: real-time/very large data, par latency aur query folding constraints. Hybrid (aggregations) dono ka mixture deta hai.
questions.explanation: Latency vs freshness.

questions.question: Data model me dimension table me duplicate rows hone par kya hoga?
questions.answer: Relationship ambiguous ban jaata hai, filters unexpected propagate hote hain aur visuals wrong aggregate karte hain. Fix: duplicate detect + dedupe with surrogate key, aur uniqueness test.
questions.explanation: Dimension keys unique hone chahiye.

questions.question: Report performance slow hai — pehla diagnostic kya?
questions.answer: Performance Analyzer se top visuals + DAX query times nikalo, cardinality-heavy columns (high distinct count) dekho, aur model size (memory) check karo. Aksar ek visual ka bi-directional filter ya high-cardinality column culprit hota hai.
questions.explanation: Measure per visual.

questions.question: Null aur unknown dimensions ko kaise handle karte ho?
questions.answer: 'Unknown'/'Not specified' member dimension me explicitly rakho — warna fans out joins ya rows gayab ho jaate hain. Fact me null foreign key ko Unknown (id -1) me map karo.
questions.explanation: Unknown member rakho.

questions.question: Same metric ke do numbers (report vs source) — kaise reconcile karoge?
questions.answer: Query ko source par dobara chalाओ with exact filters (date range, status, grain), phir step-by-step ek filter hatao/add karo jab tak numbers match hon. Reconciled definition ko documentation me lock karo.
questions.explanation: Filter-by-filter reconcile.

questions.question: Dashboard ka grand total individual rows ke sum se match nahi karta (distinct count case). Diagnose.
questions.answer: Non-additive metric (distinct customers) hai — individual sums se total zyada aata hai kyunki same customer kai rows me aata hai. Fix: total ke liye distinct count se calculate karo aur column me 'non-additive' note do.
questions.explanation: Distinct count additive nahi.

questions.question: Sales report me ek din ka data double dikh raha hai. Root cause?
questions.answer: Fact table me duplicates (retry/double load) ya join ne rows multiply kiye (many-to-many). Fix: load idempotency (unique keys), load-date audit, aur ek test jo daily totals expected fixture se compare kare.
questions.explanation: Load idempotency ka issue.

questions.question: Filter lagane par measure blank ho jaata hai. Kaunse cases?
questions.answer: Missing relation (filter table connect nahi), bi-directional off (filter propagate nahi hui), ya inactive relationship active nahi hua. Model diagram me relationship ka direction aur cross-filtering check karo.
questions.explanation: Relationship configuration.

questions.question: Currency conversion report me total galat aata hai. Fix approach?
questions.answer: Currency rate ek dimension/table me date-based rakho aur conversion ko measure me lagao (SUM(amount * rate)), aggregate karne ke baad convert nahi. Rate grain (daily/monthly) document karo; missing rates ko 1 na maano.
questions.explanation: Row level par convert, then aggregate.

questions.question: Report me last month ke numbers 0 dikh rahe hain jabki data aaya hai. Pehla check?
questions.answer: Date classification/date range (date table refresh), timezone boundary, aur incremental refresh window. Aksar date dimension purane range par hi rehta hai.
questions.explanation: Date table refresh check karo.

questions.question: Refresh 4 ghante le raha hai. Optimize kaise karoge?
questions.answer: Incremental refresh (sirf naya window), unnecessary columns/tables hatao, query folding verify karo, aur heavy transformations source (SQL/warehouse) par shift karo. Partition strategy se refresh window chhota karo.
questions.explanation: Incremental + folding + source pushdown.

questions.question: Visual me top-5 dikha rahe hain par kaek product gayab hai jo fact table me hai. Wajah?
questions.answer: Visual-level filter ya top-N ka tie-breaking (ek hi value par kai products) ki wajah se. Fix: deterministic sort key (value + id) aur tie cases ke liye 'Others'.
questions.explanation: Ties ke liye deterministic sort.

questions.question: DIVIDE se divide-by-zero se bacha, par output 0 aur blank ka farq confusion kar raha hai. Kya karo?
questions.answer: Intent decide karo: 'no data' ko blank rakho (visual me achha dikhta hai) aur galat 0 se bachao; display me custom format string se '-' dikhao aur tooltip me explanation.
questions.explanation: Blank vs 0 = semantic choice.

questions.question: Report ka 'as of' date aur source system ka date alag hai. Kaunsi galti?
questions.answer: Timezone (UTC vs local) ya refresh lag. Fix: sab UTC me store karo, display timezone explicit karo, aur refresh timestamp report header me dikhao.
questions.explanation: Timezone + refresh timestamp.

questions.question: Measure ka performance bahut slow hai (10s+). Typical culprits?
questions.answer: Row-level iteration (SUMX over high-cardinality table), bi-directional relationships, nested iterators, aur FILTER(table) instead of KEEPFILTERS/boolean filter. Optimize: aggregate first, filter columns not tables, aur measure ko decompose karke profile karo.
questions.explanation: Iterators + bi-di relationships.

questions.question: Slicer me ek value select karne par total same rehta hai. Bug?
questions.answer: Measure me ALL() use hua hai jo slicer ko ignore karta hai (ya context transition missing). Fix: ALLSELECTED use karo (slicer respect) aur measure ka intent document karo.
questions.explanation: ALL slicer ignore karta hai.

questions.question: Numbers me 0.5% ka farq do reports me hai (rounding). Kaise fix karoge?
questions.answer: Rounding ka point decide karo (aggregate ke baad round, pehle nahi) aur decimal places consistent rakho. Ek hi 'rounded metric' layer banao aur baki reports wahi use karein.
questions.explanation: Round karne ki jagah matter karti hai.

questions.question: Text column par sort se months alphabetical ho jaate hain (April, August, …). Fix?
questions.answer: Month ko numeric sort column (month_number) ya date dimension ke saath rakho — display text, sort numeric. Ye classic date modelling mistake hai.
questions.explanation: Sort column numeric rakho.

questions.question: Report ka filter context test kaise karoge (manual clicking se better)?
questions.answer: Golden query tests: same filters ke saath expected numbers assert karo (DAX/Power BI REST API ya warehouse query se), aur model change par CI me chalao.
questions.explanation: Assertions, manual clicking nahi.

questions.question: Null customer names report me blank dikhate hain. Fix?
questions.answer: Dimension me 'Unknown' member me map karo aur report me '(unknown)' label dikhao; saath me null rate metric rakho taaki data quality monitor ho.
questions.explanation: Unknown ko visible banao.

questions.question: BI me role-level security test karna hai — kya karo?
questions.answer: RLS roles ko test users ke saath impersonate karke verify karo, aur automated test rakho jo restricted region ka data sirf allowed user ke liye assert kare. RLS ko security boundary maano, UI filter nahi.

questions.question: Monthly revenue Jan 120000, Feb 150000, Mar 90000 — Feb aur Mar ka MoM growth % kya hoga?
questions.answer: Feb = +25.0%, Mar = -40.0% — formula `(cur - prev) / prev * 100`. Dhyan do ki base month zero/khaali ho to division by zero aata hai, isliye `NULLIF` ya guard chahiye.
questions.explanation: Pehle output predict karo, phir compare karo.

questions.question: KPI: total revenue, best month, MoM growth — calculation order likho.
questions.answer: Pehle per-month aggregate (GROUP BY month — grain fix), phir total = SUM, best = MAX by revenue, phir MoM = window `LAG(revenue) OVER (ORDER BY month)`. Order matter karta hai: aggregate se pehle MoM nikalna galat deta hai (row-level pe growth).
questions.explanation: Pehle output predict karo, phir compare karo.

questions.question: Dashboard me total sahi hai par per-region totals ka sum mismatch hai — likely cause?
questions.answer: Grain ka fan-out: order-items level join se rows multiply ho gayi (double counting), ya filter context alag hai (page-level filter vs visual filter), ya koi NULL/unknown bucket ek jagah count ho raha hai doosri jagah nahi. Pehle grain confirm karo: 1 row = 1 order ya 1 order-item?
questions.explanation: Pehle output predict karo, phir compare karo.

questions.question: Kaun sa edge case growth ya percentage metrics ko todta hai?
questions.answer: Zero/missing base period (naya segment pehle month 0 → division by zero ya infinity) aur seasonality (Dec vs Jan ka naive comparison). Fix: base zero ho to 'n/a' dikhao (NULLIF/guard) aur same-period-last-year comparison saath rakho.
questions.explanation: Pehle output predict karo, phir compare karo.

questions.question: Data quality checks source par lagao ya BI model me?
questions.answer: Primary checks source/ELT par (grain, key uniqueness, null rates, referential integrity) taaki model saaf data par bane; Power BI me sirf display-level sanity (totals reconcile, outliers visible). DAX me data cleaning karna tech debt hai — logic do jagah bikharta hai.
questions.explanation: Pehle output predict karo, phir compare karo.

questions.question: Dashboard slow hai — pehle kya optimize karoge?
questions.answer: Pehle model (star schema, correct grain, unnecessary columns/relationships hatao), phir DAX (iterator `SUMX` ki jagah column aggregate, `CALCULATE` filter count kam karo), phir visual count aur incremental refresh. Measure page ka time sabse pehle.
questions.explanation: Pehle output predict karo, phir compare karo.

questions.question: Dashboard me 20 KPIs dikhana sahi hai?
questions.answer: Usually nahi. User role aur decision ke hisaab se top KPIs, drill-down, filters aur alerts design karo. Dashboard ka purpose decision enable karna hai, data dump karna nahi.
questions.explanation: Playbook ke related section se verify karo.

questions.question: Correlation high ho to causation prove hota hai?
questions.answer: Nahi. Confounding, reverse causality aur selection bias possible hain. Causal claim ke liye experiment ya stronger identification strategy chahiye.
questions.explanation: Playbook ke related section se verify karo.

questions.question: Class imbalance me accuracy misleading kyun ho sakti hai?
questions.answer: Agar positive class rare hai to all-negative prediction bhi high accuracy de sakta hai. Precision, recall, PR-AUC aur business cost matrix zyada informative ho sakte hain.
questions.explanation: Playbook ke related section se verify karo.

questions.question: Model probability calibrated kyun hona chahiye?
questions.answer: Agar 0.8 score ka matlab repeatedly 80% event likelihood nahi hai, to thresholding aur risk decisions unreliable ho sakte hain. Calibration curves/Brier-style checks useful hain.
questions.explanation: Playbook ke related section se verify karo.

questions.question: Train-test split me group leakage kya hai?
questions.answer: Same customer/device/document ke related rows train aur test dono me chale gaye to score unrealistically high ho sakta hai. Group-aware split use karo.
questions.explanation: Playbook ke related section se verify karo.

questions.question: Experiment me primary aur guardrail metric kya?
questions.answer: Primary metric main success criterion hai; guardrail metric harmful side-effects jaise latency, churn, refunds ya error rate detect karta hai.
questions.explanation: Playbook ke related section se verify karo.

questions.question: Feature distribution production me badal jaye to?
questions.answer: Drift monitor karo, root cause dekho, threshold/model retrain ya feature pipeline fix karo, aur historical comparison maintain karo.
questions.explanation: Playbook ke related section se verify karo.

questions.question: SQL me LEFT JOIN ke baad row count achanak kyun badh sakta hai?
questions.answer: Right table me one-to-many match ho sakta hai. Grain check karo aur join key uniqueness validate karo.
questions.explanation: Playbook ke related section se verify karo.

questions.question: WHERE aur HAVING me difference?
questions.answer: WHERE rows ko grouping se pehle filter karta hai; HAVING aggregate/group result ko filter karta hai.

questions.question: ROW_NUMBER aur RANK me difference?
questions.answer: ROW_NUMBER unique sequence deta hai; RANK ties par same rank de sakta hai aur gaps aa sakte hain.
questions.explanation: Playbook ke related section se verify karo.

questions.question: Cohort analysis kya solve karta hai?
questions.answer: Same start event/time wale users ko group karke retention, revenue ya engagement ko time ke saath compare karta hai.
questions.explanation: Playbook ke related section se verify karo.

questions.question: Funnel analysis me sabse common mistake kya hai?
questions.answer: Different events ko inconsistent user/session grain par compare karna. Har stage ka definition aur denominator clear rakho.
questions.explanation: Playbook ke related section se verify karo.

questions.question: Dashboard me metric conflict kaise solve karoge?
questions.answer: Single semantic definition, owner, source-of-truth, refresh rule aur metric contract publish karo.
questions.explanation: Playbook ke related section se verify karo.

questions.question: Data me outlier dekh kar remove kar doge?
questions.answer: Automatically nahi. Pehle identify karo ki outlier error hai, rare valid event hai ya segment behavior.
questions.explanation: Playbook ke related section se verify karo.

questions.question: A/B test dashboard me kya dikhaoge?
questions.answer: Primary metric, confidence interval, guardrails, sample size, segment breakdown aur experiment status.
questions.explanation: Playbook ke related section se verify karo.

questions.question: SQL query slow hai to pehla step kya?
questions.answer: Query plan dekho, scan volume/join order/index/partition pruning aur unnecessary columns check karo.
questions.explanation: Playbook ke related section se verify karo.

questions.question: AI analytics copilot ko raw DB access doge?
questions.answer: Nahi. Read-only scoped identity, allowlisted schemas, parser/validator, row/scan limits aur timeout use karunga.
questions.explanation: Playbook ke related section se verify karo.

questions.question: Metric definition me grain kya?
questions.answer: Ek row kis business entity/time unit ko represent karti hai; grain wrong hua to aggregates double-count ho sakte hain.
questions.explanation: Playbook ke related section se verify karo.

questions.question: Cohort retention ka denominator?
questions.answer: Har cohort ke baseline population ko clearly define karke later periods me active users divided by that cohort baseline.
questions.explanation: Playbook ke related section se verify karo.

questions.question: Dashboard alert kab create karoge?
questions.answer: Jab deviation meaningful ho, action clear ho aur noise manageable ho.
questions.explanation: Playbook ke related section se verify karo.

questions.question: SQL dedup ka common pattern?
questions.answer: ROW_NUMBER over business key ordered by event/update timestamp, then rn = 1.
questions.explanation: Playbook ke related section se verify karo.

questions.question: Analyst AI copilot ko reliable kaise?
questions.answer: Semantic schema, read-only access, SQL validation, query limits, result checks and cited metric definitions.
questions.explanation: Playbook ke related section se verify karo.

questions.question: Correlation high hai to action loge?
questions.answer: Correlation hypothesis generate karta hai; business action se pehle confounders aur causal evidence check karunga.
questions.explanation: Playbook ke related section se verify karo.

questions.question: Grain kya hota hai?
questions.answer: Ek row kis business event/entity/time level ko represent karti hai. Grain galat hua to joins ke baad double counting ho sakti hai.
questions.explanation: Playbook ke related section se verify karo.

questions.question: LEFT JOIN se rows double kyun hoti hain?
questions.answer: Agar right table me join key par multiple matches hain to one-to-many multiplication hoti hai. Pehle grain aur key uniqueness verify karo.
questions.explanation: Playbook ke related section se verify karo.

questions.question: Window function kab use karoge?
questions.answer: Row context preserve rakhte hue ranking, running totals, lag/lead aur rolling metrics ke liye.
questions.explanation: Playbook ke related section se verify karo.

questions.question: CTE kyun useful hai?
questions.answer: Complex query ko logical stages me todne, readability badhane aur intermediate logic validate karne ke liye.
questions.explanation: Playbook ke related section se verify karo.

questions.question: Cohort analysis ka purpose?
questions.answer: Same starting event/date wale users ko group karke time ke saath retention/behavior compare karna.
questions.explanation: Playbook ke related section se verify karo.

questions.question: Retention numerator/denominator kaise define?
questions.answer: Numerator active users in a later period; denominator original cohort population. Dono definitions explicit honi chahiye.
questions.explanation: Playbook ke related section se verify karo.

questions.question: Dashboard me 100 metrics rakhna sahi hai?
questions.answer: Usually nahi. Role-specific decision metrics, supporting diagnostics aur clear ownership better hote hain.
questions.explanation: Playbook ke related section se verify karo.

questions.question: A/B test me primary metric kyun define karte?
questions.answer: Taaki success criteria experiment ke baad opportunistically change na ho. Guardrail metrics bhi predefine karo.
questions.explanation: Playbook ke related section se verify karo.

questions.question: Correlation high hai to causation?
questions.answer: Nahi. Confounders ya reverse causality possible hai. Causal claim ke liye stronger design/evidence chahiye.
questions.explanation: Playbook ke related section se verify karo.

questions.question: Data storytelling ka structure?
questions.answer: Context -> key finding -> evidence -> business impact -> action -> limitation/next step.
questions.explanation: Playbook ke related section se verify karo.
